references.text: Describes the conquest of Dan's capture of Laish (Leshem), which is the same city mentioned in Judges 18:7
Describes the actual conquest of Laish as reported by the spies in verse 7, confirming that the people lived in safety
Provides the context for why the five men were sent to scout the land, including Laish
Moses sends spies to investigate the land, a similar mission to what the five men from Dan undertook
Describes the promise of a good land where the people can live safely, which Laish represented
Ezekiel describes a people living in safety without walls or gates, similar to Laish's situation
God's promise that Israel will live safely in the land, the same safety that Laish experienced
